description: Use this when the signed-in account needs several email addresses at once, or addresses that should disappear after a deadline (one inbox per signup, trial, or job). Requires auth. Inputs: count (required; how many inboxes, capped per plan), prefix (optional; addresses become prefix-<random>@cooperemail.com, or box<random>@cooperemail.com when omitted), labels (optional strings; filter later with GET /api/v1/inboxes?label=), metadata (optional object stored on every inbox; at most 256 keys, keys at most 256 characters, values string number or boolean, serialized at most 16 KB), signature (optional {text, html?} stored on every inbox in the batch), ttl_hours (optional hours until expiry) or expires_at (optional ISO-8601 timestamp). Pass at most one of ttl_hours and expires_at. Returns {object:"list", data:[{id, username, email, display_name, created_at, require_sender_auth, labels, expires_at, status, paused_at, metadata, client_id, signature}]}. signature is {text, html} or null. Temporary inboxes count toward the plan inbox limit until they expire. The daily cron deletes expired inboxes and they then stop counting. Fails with 400 batch_count_exceeded when count is above the per-plan cap, 400 invalid_metadata, or 402 with upgrade_url when the plan inbox limit would be exceeded.

count.description: How many inboxes to create. Capped per plan; each one counts toward the plan inbox limit.

expires_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 expiry. Do not send this together with ttl_hours.

labels.description: Optional labels stored on every inbox in the batch.

metadata.description: Optional caller data stored on every inbox in the batch. At most 256 keys, each key at most 256 characters, values string number or boolean, serialized at most 16 KB. Otherwise 400 invalid_metadata.

prefix.description: Optional local-part prefix. Addresses are prefix-<random>@cooperemail.com.

signature.description: Use this when every inbox in the batch should carry the same signature. text is required (non-empty, at most 2000 characters). html is optional (at most 10000 characters).

html.description: Optional HTML version of the signature for HTML sends.

text.description: Plain-text signature added to the end of each send. Required when signature is set.

ttl_hours.description: Optional lifetime in hours. Omit both ttl_hours and expires_at for permanent inboxes.

name: cooper_create_inboxes

outputSchema.description: The inboxes created in this batch.

data.description: Items on this page, in the order the tool description gives.

client_id.description: Caller idempotency key stored with the object, or null.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

email.description: Full email address of the inbox.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object expires, or null for no expiry.

id.description: Inbox id (inb_…). Pass it as inbox_id to other tools.

metadata.description: Caller key-value data stored on the object.

paused_at.description: ISO-8601 time the inbox was paused, or null.

require_sender_auth.description: When true, only mail that passes DMARC/DKIM can create an owner task.

screening.description: Inbound screening mode: off, observe, or hold.

send_mode.description: direct sends immediately. approval turns sends into drafts a verified owner approves.

signature.description: Signature {text, html} added to sends, or null.

notices.description: Usage notices, such as [{type: limit_warning, resource, used, limit, upgrade_url}] at 80 percent of a plan limit.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

title: Create inboxes in a batch
